summary: Iteration 10 polish verification (frontend-only): POLISH 1 (compass responsive size) PASSES - CompassRose measures 220x220 at viewport widths 390 and 399, and 260x260 at widths 400 and 480 (boundary '< 400' works correctly). POLISH 2 (pointerEvents deprecation) PARTIALLY DONE - app source code in src/components/WindRose.tsx and src/components/CompassRose.tsx has been fully migrated (all four occurrences now use style.pointerEvents, grep confirms zero prop-form pointerEvents= in /app/frontend/app or /app/frontend/src). HOWEVER, the console still emits 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warnings originating from third-party @react-navigation/bottom-tabs internals (BottomTabView, BottomTabBar, ResourceSavingView). App code is compliant; the warning cannot reach ZERO without an upstream react-navigation upgrade. critical_code_review_comments: CompassRose size logic (inflight.tsx:24-25) uses useWindowDimensions with a hard threshold of 400 - clean and correct.

In CompassRose.tsx line 105 and WindRose.tsx line 88, pointerEvents is applied via inline style array [styles.center, { pointerEvents: 'none' }] - this is the recommended react-native-web-compatible pattern.
WindRose.tsx lines 71 and 82 use pointerEvents inside a single inline style object - also correct.

rca_of_issue: The 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning is fired by react-native-web/dist/modules/createDOMProps/index.js line 808 whenever any View receives pointerEvents as a component prop. Root cause of the residual warning is not in app code - it is triggered by @react-navigation/bottom-tabs source files that still pass pointerEvents as a prop (BottomTabView.tsx, BottomTabBar.tsx, ResourceSavingView.tsx). Mitigation: upgrade @react-navigation, or suppress with LogBox.ignoreLogs(['props.pointerEvents is deprecated']) in the app root layout if a cleaner console is desired without an upstream upgrade.
